purpose: Retrieve and relate identifier, naming, declaration, convention, API-contract, and web-standard evidence for AST-derived symbols.
scope_exclusions: project-specific facts in common model weights

reranker.role: deferred until reviewed hard negatives and retrieval evaluation exist

encoding.query_instruction: Given a software convention query in Korean or English, retrieve direct evidence about identifiers, naming, declarations, code quality, API contracts, and web standards.

training.hard_negative_policy: Use same-language, same-framework, or lexically similar rules that do not apply to the AST symbol. Never use another valid rule for the same symbol as a negative.
training.split_policy: Split by source snapshot and later by repository, project, feature, and commit. Never randomly split neighboring chunks from the same document or repository across train and evaluation.
readiness_gates: automatic rules have a reviewed status
public-code AST examples are linked to applicable rule_id values
hard negatives are checked for false-negative conflicts
a held-out retrieval evaluation set exists

decision_rules: AST parser output is authoritative for symbol kind and structural edges.
The embedding model retrieves semantic rules and related concepts; it does not overwrite AST facts.
Every learned rule retains source URL and source content SHA-256.
Low-confidence automatic rules remain candidates until reviewed.
Personal-project symbols are isolated in project indexes and are not added to common model weights by default.
No TC field, prompt, label, or recommendation is included in this training stage.
